40022551.author: पदार्थः
40022551.content: तत् that, अद्भुततमम् most wonderful, वाक्यम् statement, श्रुत्वा having heard, अगस्त्यस्य of Agastya, राघवः Rama, गौरवात् out of respect, विस्मयात् out of wonder, च and, एव indeed, पुनः again, प्रष्टुम् to ask, प्रचक्रमे began.

40022551.author: Translation
40022551.content: Having heard that most wonderful statement from Agastya, Rama, out of both respect and wonder, began to ask again.

40022552.author: पदार्थः
40022552.content: भगवन् O venerable one, तत् that, वनम् forest, घोरम् dreadful, तपः penance, तप्यति performs, यत्र where, सः he, श्वेतः Shveta, वैदर्भकः of Vidarbha, राजा king, कथम् how, स्यात् could it be, अमृगद्विजम् without deer and birds.

40022552.author: Translation
40022552.content: O venerable one, how could that dreadful forest, where King Shveta of Vidarbha performed penance, be devoid of deer and birds?

40022553.author: पदार्थः
40022553.content: तत् that, वनम् forest, सः he, कथम् how, राजा king, शून्यम् empty, मनुजवर्जितम् devoid of humans, तपः penance, चर्तुम् to perform, प्रविष्टः entered, सः he, श्रोतुम् to hear, इच्छामि I wish, तत्त्वतः truly.

40022553.author: Translation
40022553.content: I truly wish to hear how that king entered such a desolate forest, devoid of humans, to perform penance.

40022554.author: पदार्थः
40022554.content: रामस्य of Rama, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, कौतूहलसमन्वितम् filled with curiosity, वाक्यम् words, परमतेजस्वी the highly effulgent one, वक्तुम् to speak, एव indeed, उपचक्रमे began.

40022554.author: Translation
40022554.content: Having heard Rama's words, which were filled with curiosity, the highly effulgent Agastya indeed began to speak.

40022555.author: पदार्थः
40022555.content: पुरा formerly, कृतयुगे in the Krita Yuga, राम O Rama, मनुः Manu, दण्डधरः wielder of the scepter, प्रभुः lord, तस्य his, पुत्रः son, महान् great, आसीत् was, इक्ष्वाकुः Ikshvaku, कुलनन्दनः delight of the family.

40022555.author: Translation
40022555.content: O Rama, formerly in the Krita Yuga, there was a powerful lord named Manu, the wielder of the scepter, and his great son, Ikshvaku, was the delight of his family.

40022556.author: पदार्थः
40022556.content: तम् that, पुत्रम् son, पूर्वंकम् the first-born, राज्ये in the kingdom, निक्षिप्य having placed, भुवि on the earth, दुर्जयम् unconquerable, पृथिव्याम् on the earth, राजवंशानाम् of royal dynasties, भव become, कर्ता the creator, इति thus, उवाच said, ह indeed,

40022556.author: Translation
40022556.content: Having placed that unconquerable first-born son in the kingdom on earth, Manu said to him, "Become the founder of royal dynasties on this earth."

40022557.author: पदार्थः
40022557.content: तथा so, एव indeed, इति thus, प्रतिज्ञातम् was promised, पितुः by the father, पुत्रेण by the son, राघव O Rama, ततः then, परमसन्तुष्टः extremely pleased, मनुः Manu, पुत्रम् to the son, उवाच said, ह indeed,

40022557.author: Translation
40022557.content: O Rama, the son assented to his father's command, and then Manu, extremely pleased, spoke to his son.

40022558.author: पदार्थः
40022558.content: प्रीतः pleased, अस्मि I am, परमोदार O most generous one, त्वम् you, कर्ता the creator, असि are, न no, संशयः doubt, दण्डेन by punishment, च and, प्रजाः the subjects, रक्ष protect, मा do not, च and, दण्डम् punishment, अकारणे without cause,

40022558.author: Translation
40022558.content: Manu said, "O most generous one, I am pleased; you are indeed the creator, of this there is no doubt; protect the subjects with justice, but do not inflict punishment without cause."

40022559.author: पदार्थः
40022559.content: अपराधिषु on offenders, यः which, दण्डः punishment, पात्यते is inflicted, मानवेषु among men, वै indeed, सः that, दण्डः punishment, विधिवत् according to law, मुक्तः administered, स्वर्गम् to heaven, नयति leads, पार्थिवम् the king,

40022559.author: Translation
40022559.content: The punishment that is properly inflicted upon offenders among men, when administered according to law, leads the king to heaven.

40022560.author: पदार्थः
40022560.content: तस्मात् therefore, दण्डे in punishment, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, यत्नवान् diligent, भव be, पुत्रक O son, धर्मः righteousness, हि indeed, परमः supreme, लोके in the world, कुर्वतः while performing, ते for you, भविष्यति will be,

40022560.author: Translation
40022560.content: Therefore, O mighty-armed son, be diligent in administering justice, for by doing so, supreme righteousness will be yours in this world.

40022561.author: पदार्थः
40022561.content: इति thus, तं to him, बहु much, सन्दिश्य having instructed, मनुः Manu, पुत्रं his son, समाधिना with a composed mind, जगाम went, त्रिदिवं to heaven, हृष्टो delighted, ब्रह्मलोकं to the world of Brahma, सनातनम् eternal,

40022561.author: Translation
40022561.content: Having thus given many instructions to his son with a composed mind, Manu, delighted, went to the eternal world of Brahma, which is heaven.

40022562.author: पदार्थः
40022562.content: प्रयाते having departed, त्रिदिवं to heaven, तस्मिन् when he (Manu), इक्श्वाकुः Ikshvaku, अमितप्रभः of immeasurable splendor, जनयिष्ये shall I beget, कथं how, पुत्रान् sons, इति thus, चिन्तापरो absorbed in thought, अभवत् became,

40022562.author: Translation
40022562.content: When Manu had departed to heaven, Ikshvaku, who was of immeasurable splendor, became absorbed in the thought, "How shall I beget sons?"

40022563.author: पदार्थः
40022563.content: कर्मभिः by deeds, बहुरूपैः of many kinds, च and, तैस्तैः by those various, मनुसुतः Manu's son, सुतान् sons, जनयामास begot, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, शतं a hundred, देवसुतोपमान् resembling sons of gods,

40022563.author: Translation
40022563.content: The righteous son of Manu, Ikshvaku, then begot a hundred sons, resembling the sons of gods, through various kinds of rituals and deeds.

40022564.author: पदार्थः
40022564.content: तेषां among them, अवरजः the youngest, तात O dear one, सर्वेषां of all, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghu dynasty, मूढः foolish, च and, अकृतविद्यः uneducated, च and, न not, शुश्रूषति serves, पूर्वजान् his elders,

40022564.author: Translation
40022564.content: O dear Rama, the delight of the Raghu dynasty, the youngest among all those sons was foolish and uneducated, and he did not serve his elders.

40022565.author: पदार्थः
40022565.content: नाम name, तस्य his, च and, दण्डः Danda, इति thus, पिता father, चक्रे gave, अल्पमेधसः to the dull-witted one, अवश्यं certainly, दण्डपतनं the falling of punishment, शरीरे on the body, अस्य his, भविष्यति will be,

40022565.author: Translation
40022565.content: His father named that dull-witted son Danda, thinking that punishment would certainly befall his body.

40022566.author: पदार्थः
40022566.content: अपश्यमानः not finding, तम् that, देशम् region, घोरम् dreadful, पुत्रस्य of the son (Lavana), राघव O Raghava, विन्ध्यशैवलयोः of Vindhya and Shaivala, मध्ये in the middle, राज्यम् kingdom, प्रादात् established, अरिन्दम O destroyer of enemies.

40022566.author: Translation
40022566.content: O Raghava, O destroyer of enemies, not finding that dreadful region of Lavana suitable, he (Shatrughna) established a kingdom in the middle of the Vindhya and Shaivala mountains.

40022567.author: पदार्थः
40022567.content: सः he, दण्डः the wielder of justice, तत्र there, राजा king, अभूत् became, रम्ये beautiful, पर्वतरोधसि on the mountain slope, पुरम् city, च and, अप्रतिमम् unequalled, राम O Rama, न्यवेशयत् established, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed.

40022567.author: Translation
40022567.content: O Rama, he (Shatrughna), the wielder of justice, became king there on the beautiful mountain slope and established an unequalled, unsurpassed city.

40022568.author: पदार्थः
40022568.content: पुरस्य of the city, च and, अकरोत् made, नाम name, मधुमन्तम् Madhumanta, इति thus, प्रभो O Lord, पुरोहितम् priest, तु indeed, उशनसम् Ushanas, वरयामास chose, सुव्रतम् righteous.

40022568.author: Translation
40022568.content: And, O Lord, he named the city Madhumanta and indeed chose the righteous Ushanas as his priest.

40022569.author: पदार्थः
40022569.content: एवम् thus, सः he, राजा king, तत् that, राज्यम् kingdom, अकरोत् ruled, सपुरोहितः with his priest, प्रहृष्टमनुजाकीर्णम् filled with joyful people, देवराजम् the king of gods, यथा as, वृषा Indra.

40022569.author: Translation
40022569.content: Thus, that king (Shatrughna), with his priest, ruled that kingdom, which was filled with joyful people, just as Indra rules the kingdom of the gods.

40022570.author: पदार्थः
40022570.content: ततः then, सः he, राजा king, मनुजेन्द्रपुत्रः son of the lord of men, सार्धम् together, च and, तेन with him, उशनसा Ushanas, तदानीम् at that time, चकार ruled, राज्यम् kingdom, सुमहान् very great, महात्मा great-souled, शक्रः Indra, दिवि in heaven, इव like, उशनसा with Ushanas, समेतः accompanied by.

40022570.author: Translation
40022570.content: Then, that great-souled king, the son of the lord of men (Shatrughna), together with Ushanas at that time, ruled the very great kingdom, just as Indra, accompanied by Ushanas, rules in heaven. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकोनशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 79 ।। Thus ends the seventy-ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
